Improves liquidity and addresses near-term obligations; sub debt ranks below seniors but adds runway.
Removes delivery obligations tied to prior financing, reducing operational overhang.
Ownership shift may ease China-linked overhang; new investor could alter governance.
Immediate governance change; signals end of Triumph influence.
Indicates ongoing lender support; terms undisclosed, watch cost of capital.
